suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add guidance about Nix path resolution when importing relative paths from different directory levels in flakes. Workers should understand that relative paths in Nix imports are relative to the importing file's location, not the flake root.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Worker in nixos-common-modules-divergence-fix encountered path resolution issues when moving file to modules/ directory, requiring relocation to root directory with updated import paths. This caused temporary evaluation failures.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add specific guidance about git tracking requirements in Nix flakes. Workers must remember to 'git add' new files before they can be referenced in flake inputs, as flakes only include git-tracked files.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Worker discovered this the hard way when common-modules-list.nix wasn't being evaluated until explicitly added to git.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add knowledge entry about Nix flake path resolution patterns and git tracking requirements.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Both path resolution and git tracking issues were encountered and resolved during implementation, representing valuable knowledge for future workers.
